CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_DEBT.title: Debt
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_DEBT.description: At end of turn, gain 1 Debt for each negative Energy. At the start of next turn, lose that much Energy.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_ELITE_TWO.title: Elite Two
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_ELITE_TWO.descriptio: Transform a Support card into its Elite Two form while preserving its current upgrade state.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_UPGRADE_ACTION.title: Upgrade
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_UPGRADE_ACTION.descr: Turn a card into its upgraded form, strengthening its values or effects.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_ATTACK_MODULE.title: Attack Module
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_ATTACK_MODULE.descri: When you deal damage, deal additional damage equal to the Attack Module's maximum HP.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_DEFENSE_MODULE.title: Defense Module
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_DEFENSE_MODULE.descr: When you gain Block, gain additional Block equal to the Defense Module's maximum HP.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_SUPPORT_MODULE.title: Support Module
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_SUPPORT_MODULE.descr: When you take damage, heal HP equal to the Support Module's maximum HP.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_INHERIT.title: Inherit
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_INHERIT.description: When automatically played by another X-cost card, use that card's X value to resolve this card without spending additional Energy.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_STUN.title: Stun
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_STUN.description: Enemies cannot act on their next turn. The player can play only 1 card this turn.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_DAZE.title: Daze
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_DAZE.description: The player can play only 1 card this turn.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_HAND_RETAIN.title: Retain
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_HAND_RETAIN.descript: Cards in your hand are not discarded at the end of this turn.
